subject: Post-call: evidence & decision items for deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@certabank.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@certabank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: evidence & decision items for deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Hi Samir / Olivia — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and what we need to help you decide between Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, and Private (VPC/on-prem):

1) Summary of the call
- You're evaluating a pilot for conversational fraud detection and redaction.
- Primary drivers: customer-managed keys (HSM), strict log immutability/retention (7+ years), and SSO with SAML/SCIM integration to your IdP.
- Initial expected QPS is modest (50–200 qps), but SLOs require sub-300ms p99 for short prompts.

2) Items we agreed we would provide / you asked for
- Redwood: an evidence packet showing how Private supports customer-managed HSM integration (tech note + required interfaces). Attached: redwood-sso-kms-evidence-template.pdf (we'll fill this).
- Redwood: sample log retention/immutability options and how we implement write-once/retention controls for Private vs Dedicated.
- Redwood: SOC2 + architecture diagram for Hosted to show isolation boundaries.
- Certabank: confirmation on HSM posture (BYOK vs Redwood-managed KMS) and a short spreadsheet with retention law requirements (you said legal needs 7 years immutable).

3) Questions / clarifications for you
- Does your compliance team require on-prem HSM hardware, or will a cloud HSM (BYOK with HSM-backed keys) suffice?
- Are there any specific cipher-suite or FIPS certifications we should reference (e.g., FIPS 140-2 level X)?
- Can you confirm the maximum retention window for audit logs (you mentioned 7 years; is any portion subject to longer retention)?

4) Proposed next steps & owners
- Marcus: I will populate and send the evidence packet by EOD 11/23. (Owner: marcus_lin)
- Aditya: schedule a technical deep-dive (HSM/KMS + network diagram) with your infra team — proposed week of 11/29. (Owner: aditya_rao)
- Laura: pull procurement/gov approval checklist and draft SOW options for Private vs Dedicated pricing. (Owner: laura_bennett)
- Samir/Olivia: send the retention spreadsheet and confirm HSM posture by 11/25.

Attachments: redwood-sso-kms-evidence-template.pdf (attached).

Thanks — will follow up with the filled template and a link to a short HubSpot checklist for tracking.

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@certabank.com>

Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@certabank.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T17:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: evidence & decision items for deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Thanks Marcus — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- HSM posture: our security team requires HSM-backed keys under our control. We prefer BYOH (bring-your-own-hsm) meaning the HSM appliance sits in our infrastructure and we expect Redwood to integrate via a keywrap/key-encrypt-key model or support an HSM proxy. If that's a hard no, we have a path to use a cloud HSM but it will add governance steps.
- FIPS: we need confirmation of FIPS 140-2 validated crypto for any keys used in production.
- Logs: legal confirmed 7 years immutable for audit trails. Additionally, some payment-related fields may need tamper-evidence for 10 years. I attached our retention breakdown.

Can you also send a sample network diagram showing connectivity requirements for Private (VPC peering, private endpoints, egress lock-down)? That will help our infra team.

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Infrastructure Security | CertaBank
samir.patel@certabank.com | +1 (617) 555-2233

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@certabank.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@certabank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: evidence & decision items for deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Samir — really helpful, thanks. Quick responses inline and next steps: 

- BYOH / HSM: Redwood Private supports customer-side HSM integration patterns. We don’t require you to hand over keys; instead we integrate using an HSM gateway or keywrap pattern. I will include a technical appendix that shows both approaches (HSM proxy and cloud-HSM BYOK).
- FIPS: we will include our KMS/HSM compatibility statement and the cryptographic modules we’ve validated against FIPS 140-2.
- Logs: will include the retention modes (immutable WORM stores, retention lockers) and the export formats your legal team can ingest. For the 10-year payment-related requirement, we can surface a plan that writes to your long-term immutable store via our export connectors.
- Network diagram: attaching a preliminary Private deployment diagram and a checklist of ports/endpoints. Aditya — can you own a technical call with Samir/Olivia next week? Proposed slots: 11/30 09:00–10:00 PT or 12/01 14:00–15:00 PT.

Proposed PoC timeline (high level): 
- Week 0–1: SOW sign + access provisioning
- Week 2–3: HSM/KMS integration + SSO test config
- Week 4: Logging pipeline + retention verification
- Week 5–6: Performance tuning and go/no-go for pilot

I'll upload the filled evidence template by EOD and include links to the Private deployment docs and our SOC2 package. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/DEAL-2026-CRB-44

Thanks,
Marcus

---
Attachment stubs: redwood-private-deploy-diagram.pdf (pdf, 220 KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: procurement + pricing strategy for CertaBank (DEAL-2026-CRB-44)

Marcus / Neha — short internal note to align on procurement path and discounts: 

- Given the HSM and 7+ year retention ask, this is trending toward Private deployment (high integration cost and legal overhead). Dedicated could be an option only if we can meet BYOK and retention via exported immutable store — likely more complex.
- Suggest we prepare 2 SOW options: (A) Private full integration (recommended) with a 12-month commitment; (B) Dedicated trial (3 months) with clear gating that requires a follow-on Private conversion if HSM BYOH is needed.
- Pricing: propose a pilot credit of 40% off MRR for first 3 months to get them past procurement hurdles, then standard enterprise pricing for ongoing. Laura will draft and circulate a procurement checklist and SOW templates by EOD 11/24.

I'll loop in Legal for the HSM addendum once Marcus confirms the technical approach.

Laura
